name: flux-2-klein-9B-360-erp-outpaint-lora
notes: NEW Jun 10. Panoramic 360 ERP outpaint LoRA for FLUX.2-klein-9B. ComfyUI-tagged. Apache 2.0 (4B variant). Fits spellcaster lora prefix injection. Companion: flux-2-klein-4B-360-erp-outpaint-lora.

name: flux-2-klein-4B-360-erp-outpaint-lora
notes: NEW Jun 10. 4B variant of the 360 ERP outpaint LoRA. Apache 2.0.

name: Ideogram 4.0 nf4
notes: NEW Jun 3-4. 9.3B DiT, Ideogram4Pipeline, Qwen3-VL encoder, FLUX2 VAE. Best-in-class text-in-image. Non-commercial gated. Needs new build_ideogram_txt2img builder. nf4 fits 16 GB; fp8 borderline. Day-0 ComfyUI v0.24.0 support.

name: SwiftVR
notes: NEW Jun 8 (paper). Real-time 4K VSR via shifted-window self-attention + lightweight Restoration-aware Autoencoder. Consumer GPU target. No weights confirmed yet. Watch for HF weights release.

name: SeedEdit 3.0
notes: NEW Jun 5 (paper). Direct successor to SeedEdit v2 (build_seedv2r target). 4K editing, 56.1% usability vs GPT-4o 37.1%. API-only via ByteDance Seed platform. Watch seed.bytedance.com for local weights.

name: HunyuanVideo-1.5
notes: Released Nov 2025; HF repo updated Jun 5 2026 (borderline). 8.3B SSTA attention, ~2x more efficient than original HunyuanVideo. FP8+CPU offload fits 14-16 GB. ComfyUI-MagCache provides 1.7x speedup. Likely supersedes current build_hunyuan_video checkpoint path.

name: LTX-2.3 22B
notes: Mar 5 2026. Adds audio co-generation (new output dimension). ComfyUI v0.16.1+ nodes. GGUF Q4_K_S fits 10 GB. Needs a new builder (build_ltx23_video); keep existing for LTX <=2.0.

name: Wan 2.7 MoE
notes: Apr-May 2026. 27B MoE (14B active). T2V, I2V, reference-to-video, voice cloning, instruction editing. Apache 2.0. Weights on ModelScope; HF Wan-AI org still at 2.2. ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper MoE support unconfirmed. GGUF Q4/Q5 needed for 16 GB — community quants have 1-2 week lag. Also affects build_wan22_t2v, build_wan_flf, build_wan_animate_video, build_wan_video_blockswap, build_wan_video_blockswap_t2v.

name: SAM 3.1 Multiplex
notes: Mar 27 2026. Processes up to 16 tracked objects in single pass, 2x throughput (16->32 fps on H100). Checkpoint: sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors. ComfyUI PR #13408. Drop-in model swap for build_sam3_segment, build_sam3_mask, build_sam3_extract.

name: Hunyuan3D 3.0 Partner Nodes
notes: ComfyUI Partner Nodes integration Feb 13 2026. 3D-DiT hierarchical sculpting, geo resolution 15363 (3x over 2.0). Text/image/sketch input. Weights on tencent/Hunyuan3D HF org. Confirm VRAM headroom for 16 GB. Also affects build_hunyuan_3d_textured.

name: HyperSwap 1c ONNX
notes: FaceFusion Labs next-gen ONNX swap models: hyperswap_1a/1b/1c_256.onnx (403 MB each). 1c = highest quality. Drop-in for inswapper_128.onnx — swap_model param already accepts arbitrary ONNX filenames. ReActor ComfyUI node supports. Sub-1 GB VRAM. Also covers build_faceswap_model.

name: HyperSwap 1c ONNX (photobooth)
notes: Same HyperSwap 1c model. build_photobooth hardcoded to reswapper_256.onnx — one-line param update to hyperswap_1c_256.onnx.

name: NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution
notes: Feb 2026. Tensor Core upscaling (non-diffusion), 30x faster than diffusion alternatives. RTX 5060 Ti NVFP4 native. Node: Nvidia_RTX_Nodes_ComfyUI/rtx-video-super-resolution. Add as fast-path toggle in build_wavespeed_upscale.

name: SeedVR2-7B GGUF Q8 (ICLR 2026)
notes: SeedVR2 v2 ICLR 2026 final. Weights live. GGUF Q4_K_M/Q8_0 available via numz node v2.5+ (ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler). 7B confirmed working on RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB. Verify builder targets -7B not -3B and node is >=v2.5.

name: facerestore_advanced
notes: SSIM/artifact detection QA + intelligent model fallback over bare CodeFormer/GFPGAN. Does not replace model weights — smarter orchestration. Most valuable for build_photo_restore on degraded inputs. Needs new node install; wraps same underlying models.

name: BiRefNet_HR
notes: Feb 4 2026 refresh. High-res variant of BiRefNet for upscaled/print-res inputs. 711K+ downloads. ComfyUI-RMBG v3.0.0 already supports. Add as HR path option alongside BiRefNet-general.

name: FlashVSR
notes: CVPR 2026. One-step diffusion streaming VSR via locality-constrained sparse attention. 3 ComfyUI wrappers: 1038lab/ComfyUI-FlashVSR, naxci1/ComfyUI-FlashVSR_Stable (VRAM OOM protection), smthemex/ComfyUI_FlashVSR. LightVAE_W2.1 fits 8-16 GB. Alternative to SeedVR2 for streaming upscale.

name: DreamID-V (Wan-1.3B diffusion faceswap)
notes: Jan 2026 (ByteDance). Diffusion-transformer face swap using Wan-1.3B backbone. Better identity preservation and temporal coherence than ONNX approaches. Video-oriented. ComfyUI wrappers: TTPlanetPig/Comfyui_DreamID-V_wrapper, HM-RunningHub/ComfyUI_RH_DreamID-V. ~8-10 GB VRAM estimate. Needs new image-oriented variant builder.

name: Seed3D 2.0 (ByteDance)
notes: Apr 23 2026. Dual SOTA on geometry + texture. PBR model, MoE, VLM semantic conditioning, articulation. API-only via Volcano Engine. No local weights. Watch for open-weight release.

name: NTIRE 2026 face restoration winners
notes: NTIRE 2026 challenge (CVPR 2026 workshop). 96 registrants, 9 valid submissions. Focus on richer textures + identity consistency. Winning weights not yet public. Check github.com/jkwang28/NTIRE2026_RealWorld_Face_Restoration for releases.

name: IC-Light V2 (full)
notes: Flux backbone, 16-ch VAE. FG-conditional model weights released; BG-conditional model still not open-sourced as of Jun 2026. Non-commercial license. No action until full weights released.

name: AnyDepth
notes: Jan 6 2026. DINOv3 encoder + SDT decoder. Claims higher zero-shot accuracy than DA2 with lower compute. No ComfyUI node found. GitHub: AIGeeksGroup/AnyDepth. Watch for node development.

name: FLUX.2-klein-9B-KV
notes: Mar 9 2026. KV-cache compression for ~1s inference. Affects all build_klein_* builders. FP8 variant (FLUX.2-klein-9b-kv-fp8) available, 63K downloads. ComfyUI workflow: axiomgraph/ComfyUIWorkflow. Verify if already in spellcaster arch stubs as flux2klein variant.

name: FLUX.2-small-decoder
notes: Apr 6 2026. Apache 2.0. 28M params vs 50M full decoder. 1.4x faster decode, -1.4x VRAM. Drop-in for flux2-vae.safetensors in architectures.py extra[vae_name]. 377K downloads. Apply to all FLUX.2 paths: build_klein_*, build_txt2img (flux), build_pulid_flux.
